correctness.rationale: TARGET route (claim_route=TARGET): draft claims proved nondisplaceability e=+inf. Machine checks reproduced (W0/W' grads/Hessians, Markov (2,3,6)/(1,5,5) enumeration, 18-term balanced-hull det 36963). But headline depends on explicit unproved hypothesis (H-mono): true endpoint W_T0 has nondegenerate positive-real critical point. Only the unit-count model (all n_beta=1) is verified; true open-GW coefficients are admitted uncomputed. Openness/support-disjointness cannot create existence of a critical point nor its nondegeneracy without the true coefficients. One-step cluster demo does not cover 8 blowup term-adding steps. Sheridan/FOOO criterion therefore has no verified antecedent. This is evidence plus cited theorems with a load-bearing gap, not a proof.
